typography.rules: H1 max text-5xl on desktop, text-4xl on mobile with tracking-tight. Body uses leading-relaxed. NEVER use Inter for headings.

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast with Trust accents (Blue & Orange)

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use crisp 1px borders with subtle shadow-sm for cards. For header, use Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl + bg-background/80) with a bottom border.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive elements must have explicit hover states (e.g., hover:translate-y-[-2px] and shadow-md for cards, hover:bg-primary/90 for buttons).

components.header:
Sticky nav. Custom CSS logo: `
Y
`. Next to it, text 'YOGI INTERNET' and subtitle 'GAURIBIDANURU' (text-xs text-muted-foreground).
components.search: Prominent, centered hero search bar. Use Shadcn Input with a Search icon. Placeholder: 'Search applications, services, documents...'.
components.application_cards: Use Shadcn Card. Flat design, rounded-lg. Must contain Name, Description, Category Badge, Status, Date, and 'View Details' button. Display inside a '🔥 TRENDING APPLICATIONS' section.
components.application_modal: Use Shadcn Dialog. Show full description, start/last dates, status, Apply link, 'Documents Required' (check list), and 'Important Instructions' (muted box).
components.categories: Include filters for: Government Services, Education, Jobs, Scholarships, Certificates, Banking, Insurance, Online Applications, Other Services.
components.footer: Includes 'About YOGI INTERNET', editable description, and contact info (Landline, WhatsApp, Gmail clickable).
components.admin_dashboard: Stat cards (Total Applications, Trending, Published, Unpublished, Ending Soon). Data tables for full CRUD on applications, document management, and contact info editing.

layouts.spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Section padding py-16 to py-24. Mobile-first grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) for application cards.
layouts.alignment: Left-align forms and dense text. Center-align hero elements.

motion.animations: Subtle, fast animations. Use `transition-transform duration-200` for cards. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. Avoid fully transparent backgrounds for overlays.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="apply-button"`).

images.description: Person typing on laptop, use for 'About' section

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the font import into src/index.css at the top.
Update src/index.css with the provided light and dark mode CSS variables.
Implement the home page with a prominent hero search and grid of 'Trending Applications'.
Implement the custom 'Y' circular logo using Tailwind classes.
Implement Application details modal using Shadcn Dialog with Documents Required and Important Instructions.
Implement Footer with clickable contact links (whatsapp://, mailto:, tel:).
Implement the secure Admin Dashboard with stat cards and CRUD data table for applications, documents, and contacts.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Dialog, Select, Form, Table).
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>; use Shadcn alternatives.
Ensure the app is fully responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned). No 'transition: all' for universal selectors. Create depth through z-index and subtle shadows. Do not use AI-slop purple gradients. Never use emoji characters for icons; always use lucide-react. Add data-testid to everything. Do not use fully transparent backgrounds for overlays or headers.
